$comment: Every client source that produces a floating layer, with the decision the coordinator migration took for it. `pnpm check:webui-overlays` fails on a surface that is not listed, on a `managed` entry whose source never registers, and on an exception without its interaction boundary. `--strict` fails while any entry is pending.

dispositions.managed: registers with the coordinator and attaches no listener
dispositions.borrows-role: renders role="dialog" for labelling, is not a layer
dispositions.exception: cannot join; its interaction boundary is stated
dispositions.pending: not migrated yet; the reason is recorded

features/account/ui/AccountLoginDialog.t.note: the sign-in panel is a modal layer

features/account/ui/UserMenu.tsx.note: the account menu layers on the shared dropdown and closes its fly-outs on every close; the two fly-outs borrow role=dialog for labelling only and live inside that layer, and the portalled settings modal registers its own layer

features/account/ui/UserMenuUsage.tsx.note: renders role=dialog for labelling only: it is a hover/focus fly-out inside the account menu's layer and is dismissed by that menu, not by itself

features/composer/ui/ComposerEditorStagi.note: the mention and command menus; the composer region carries both layer ids

features/composer/ui/ComposerProjectRow..note: the project menu layers on the shared dropdown, and the directory browser it opens is a modal layer of its own, so the coordinator dismisses it and it holds no listener

features/goal/ui/GoalBanner.public.tsx.note: the delete-goal confirmation registers through the shared useDialogLayer, so the coordinator answers its Escape and the press outside it, and it stays put while the delete is in flight

features/models/ui/ModelPicker.public.ts.note: one layer with a ladder of its own: request-close walks list to panel, a press outside closes

features/models/ui/ProviderFormPanel.pub.note: the preset picker and the format picker

features/plugins/ui/PluginImportDialog.t.note: a modal layer; a dismissal closes it

features/plugins/ui/PluginItemDialog.tsx.note: the plugin editor and the MCP dialog, one layer each mount

features/settings/ui/MemoryManagerDialog.note: the dialog registers through the shared useDialogLayer; the menu and the confirmation name their parent outright, so dialog, menu and confirmation stay one nested path

features/settings/ui/settings-atoms.tsx.note: the shared dialog primitive registers through the shared useDialogLayer: dismissible when it offers a way out, deferred otherwise so a nested portal is not swallowed

features/transcript/ui/MessageItem.tsx.note: the fork dialog; its layer is active only while it is rendered

features/workspace/ui/WorkspaceProgressP.note: the commit dialog is a modal layer

ui/ContextMenu.tsx.note: opened at a point; a press anywhere else ends it
